attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates all ten of its members, so it is ten folders. **One open question is named in the report**: the corpus keeps a Marinus the Elder with a Romanian feast on 18 October and an undocumented Greek row, and nothing on this page says whether he is this soldier; because that row is undocumented rather than venerated, drafting a separate folder is the choice that does not overwrite a reading, and a writer who finds the two to be one man should merge them. The other Marinus the corpus keeps is a martyr of 17 March. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
